description: Hand-authored ground truth for react-fetch synthetic fixture. Three TS/JSX fetch URL shapes each produce one HTTP_CALLS edge to the matching axum handler in the sibling server crate.
notes: The fixture is split into a `server/` Rust crate and a `web/` TS/JSX directory so matchAndLink's sameService filter (strip-2 directory comparison) classes the two as cross-service. The to_qn_suffix lands on the actual handler functions (handle_items, handle_orders, handle_users_collection) because Phase D1 (PR #257) reworked matchAndLink to look up handlers via RouteHandler.HandlerRef + crate-locality bias. The fetch_id_slot.tsx URL `/api/users/${id}` extracts to `/api/users` (trailing slash trimmed) and matchAndLink pairs that against the axum route at exactly `/api/users`.
